title: Sample to-do JSON API
summary: Synthetic practice project: a small HTTP server keeping an in-memory to-do list, with JSON responses. It listens on the port in the PORT environment variable.

acceptanceChecks.text: `GET /todos` on a fresh server returns status 200 and the JSON body `[]`.
`POST /todos` with the JSON body `{"title":"buy milk"}` returns status 201 and a JSON object with `id`, `title` equal to `buy milk` and `done` equal to false.
After that POST, `GET /todos` returns a list containing the new item.
`POST /todos` with a body that has no `title` returns status 400.
